<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs`; edit the source it names instead. -->

Replace this cuilo with the newest signed release; only for copies the install script made.

## Usage

```sh
cuilo upgrade [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--check` | Only report whether a newer release exists. |

## Global options

`--root`, `--json` and `--no-input` work here too; see [global options](/reference/cli/#global-options).
